title: Sharp T-Count Lower Bounds and Symplectic-Gram Decompositions for Unary-Tracked Unitary Synthesis and Wide Fredkin Gates
abstract: We establish sharp non-asymptotic T-count lower bounds, algebraic reductions, and exact symplectic-Gram decompositions for unary-tracked Clifford+T unitary synthesis and Wide Fredkin gates, advancing the framework of Sun (arXiv:2611.34740v1). First, we prove exact stabilizer-nullity and Pauli-stabilizer lower bounds showing that any exact Clifford+T implementation of a target unitary with unary-tracked ancilla register requires T-count tightly controlled by the symplectic rank of its phase-polynomial residue, matching the constructive upper bound up to exact additive constants. Second, we derive closed-form symplectic-Gram factorizations for arbitrary-width Fredkin networks and certify exact crossover thresholds against prior Toffoli/Fredkin syntheses. Third, all algebraic cores are constructively formalized in zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) and independently verified via an AST-audited zero-float exact rational Python certificate suite with adversarial testing.
